lines.text: True love is hard to find, so I thought I'd start this rhyme
With a couple bars and lines of leavin' it all behind
I've had all the dimes (Dimes) and all are fine
But now I need the one to call her mine (Mine)
You know, that girl that everybody wants (Wants)
But can't have: fat ass, nice eyes, high class
I get the last laugh now 'cause she under my arm
Lay down, hittin' L's, lookin' up at the stars
I tell her, "Listen, I ain't gon' do you wrong
Forget what you hear in all my songs
My old ways is gone, I'ma be real wit'cha (Uh-huh)
Recently, I been lookin' at the big picture
Perfectly framed, see the way I'm workin' the game
Take my name, I'ma share all of my fortune and fame
Beauty or brains? (Brains) Girl, you all the above"
True player for real, but now I'm fallin' in love
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
My lady, my lady
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
My lady, my lady
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
You used to the bullshit, the dudes put you through it
Cupid never shot up such a nuisance (Uh-huh)
See, with me, my love is with the music
But, baby, you can be the next to it (Yup)
My boys say I'm stupid, I need to move along
And when we fight, I hope you use this song to get it right (Right)
My moms is gettin' jealous how I feel about her (About her)
And the fellas say I could deal without her
See, baby, I ain't playin' around
I don't need Cupid, dude coulda aimed at the ground
'Cause that's real (Real), real
Just had to tell you how I feel (Feel)
And the party tonight's goin' crazy
But I'm just here with my baby
I love the way that she makes me
I'ma just kick it wit' her and break trees, 'cause
I'm 'bout to get high with my lady
